title: SpaceDomainManageResult
description: space.domain-manage-result@1: answers of space.domain.manage on OpenVibe.Space. GET /api/v1/sites/:id/domains → { domains } (the default domain first). POST /api/v1/sites/:id/domains → 201 { domain } with the DNS records to publish. POST /api/v1/domains/:id/verify → { domain } after the check (status verified and served once the TXT record matches, else last_error says what was found; emits space.domain.verified). DELETE /api/v1/domains/:id → { deleted: true }.
